equation: *Objective (Eq. 1):** minimize L(S|P) = L(P) + Σ_{s∈S} L(s|P), where L(P) is the description length of the pattern set and L(s|P) the description length of sequence s encoded with the pattern set (as a code table CT / code stream CS).

*Code lengths (Appendix D, Shannon-entropy based):** pattern code L(code_p(p)) = −log2(usage(p)/Σ usage(p_i)); gap/fill/miss codes as their relative share of gaps+fills+misses, with miss codes carrying +L_N(|A|) extra bits for the missing-attribute index. L(ST) = Σ_k [ L_N(|V_k|) + log( C(|S_k|,|V_k|) ) ] (per-attribute singleton encoding); L(CT*) = L_N(|P*|) + L_N(usage(P*)) + log(|usage(P*)| multinomial over |P*|) + Σ_{p_i∈P*} L(p_i); L(p_i) = L_N(|p_i|) + L_N(||p_i||) + L_N(gaps(p_i)+1) + L_N(misses(p_i)+1) + Σ_{v∈p_i} L(code_p(v|ST)).
